reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials sheet instead of a vague cost badge. Each entry shows the materials needed for construction, allowing you to see stored versus required resources, with shortages highlighted. This change makes it easier to manage your colony's resources effectively. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: New Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges!
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a new update for Provincia that replaces the old cost badges with a comprehensive materials sheet for build tiles. This allows players to easily see what materials are required for construction, as well as stored versus required resources, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change aims to improve your resource management and overall gameplay experience. Learn more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
